judge_input.description:
## What did you change?

Went ahead and updated the logic of the Whisper tokenizer, and the particular way in which it was updated is that it now goes and uses `extra_special_tokens` instead of the way that it used to work, which was by using `additional_special_tokens`, and the specific point at which all of this comes into play is the point where the tokenizer is doing the reading and the adding of the special tokens.

---

## Why did you make this change?

Transformers v5 is a release that went right ahead and removed `tokenization_utils_fast.py` entirely and completely, and then, over and above just that one thing on its own, it additionally went and unified all of the tokenizer APIs together into one. In the meantime, and all the while that this was going on, espnet/whisper was one that still happened to be depending on the older attributes belonging to GPT2Tokenizer, which is to say that it was still depending on `additional_special_tokens`, and the direct consequence of that particular state of affairs was that errors ended up being caused whenever things came into contact with the new API. The act of switching everything over to `extra_special_tokens` instead is precisely the thing that goes ahead and fixes up the compatibility with v5.

---

## Is your PR small enough?

Yes, it genuinely is small enough. It comes to 2 files in total, and within those files there are 4 add/deletions all together.

---

## Additional Context

https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/blob/main/MIGRATION_GUIDE_V5.md
